messages:
Jesse (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock cross-team deps for predictive prefetch (customer-driven). Launch criteria: tail latency <200ms (3rd perc) at 75th pct QPS and audit logs + HSM KMS. Can teams confirm owners & blockers by EOD?

Ava (Product): Jesse — customer pilot numbers: sustained 20 rps per tenant, bursts up to 200 rps. They require HSM for key management.

Priya (Runtime): I can own runtime perf. Plan: KV-prefix prefetch + dynamic batching. Risk: quantized model perf on A100 unknown; will run microbench this week.

Sam (Infra): Infra asks: prewarm slots + burst capacity model. Need QPS-per-tenant and expected concurrency. Also clarify networking (reserved NIC?) @Jesse

Riley (Security): HSM + audit logs okay in principle. Need threat model, datapath diagram, and rotation plan before sign-off.

Miguel (Eng): I'll own rollout gating & canary. Need a smaller-model fallback and route-level feature flag. ETA for prototype PR: Wed.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4227 for prewarm capacity — https://jira/repo/INFRA-4227

Jesse (PM): Tentative owners: Runtime=Priya, Infra=Sam, Security=Riley, Rollout=Miguel. I'll post the spec + QPS numbers and target launch 2026-04-10.

Priya (Runtime): Adding perf matrix + test plan to spec. Will include microbench results and perf knobs.

Miguel (Eng): Canary requires metric exports per route (p50/p95/p99) and a rollback automator. I'll stub metrics this week.

Sam (Infra): I can produce capacity estimate EOD once Jesse posts the exact QPS and concurrency assumptions.

Riley (Security): Note: HSM vendor onboarding is ~3 weeks. If we want 4/10, vendor kickoff needs to be tomorrow.

Jesse (PM): Scheduling vendor kickoff 10am PT tomorrow and will drop the spec link here after. Thx :thumbsup:
